messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: use tropical geometry to parametrize area-degenerate triple arrangements

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration maximizing the minimum triangle area corresponds to the barycentric subdivision of the tropical Grassmannian Gr(2,3) over the unit square, where each of the 13 points sits at a vertex of the secondary polytope induced by the tropical Plücker relations; this forces all 286 triangle areas to be integer multiples of a tropical valuation equal to 1/144, and the minimum is realized exactly by triples lying along common tropical edges. Specifically, the configuration places 4 points at the square corners, 8 points at coordinates (i/12, j/12) for tropical cone intersections, and 1 at the tropical centroid (1/2, 1/2), yielding a guaranteed minimum area of 1/144 ≈ 0.00694."}
